LESSON: SARUFI 10.4.1 VINYUME VYA VITENZI NA VIELEZI

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.4: Sarufi 10.4.1 Vinyume vya Vitenzi na Vielezi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 10.4.1 Vinyume vya Vitenzi na Vielezi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya kinyume ili kuibainisha
2. kutambua vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi katika matini
3. kutumia vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi ipasavyo katika matini

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya kinyume ili kuibainisha
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya kinyume ili kuibainisha. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutumia vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi ipasavyo katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi ipasavyo katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 10.4.1 Vinyume vya Vitenzi na Vielezi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 10.4.1 Vinyume vya Vitenzi na Vielezi in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 10.4.1 Vinyume vya Vitenzi na Vielezi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 10.4.1 Vinyume vya Vitenzi na Vielezi.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya kinyume ili kuibainisha

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 10.4.1 Vinyume vya Vitenzi na Vielezi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 10.4.1 Vinyume vya Vitenzi na Vielezi important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya kinyume ili kuibainisha
2. kutambua vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi katika matini
3. kutumia vinyume vya vitenzi na vielezi ipasavyo katika matini

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
